title: Gift-Card and Voucher Expiry Watch
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=giftcard:balance balance>0
| eval days_to_expiry=round((expiry_epoch-now())/86400,0)
| where days_to_expiry>0 AND days_to_expiry<60
| sort days_to_expiry
description: Surfaces gift cards and vouchers with money left that are about to expire, so none goes to waste.
value: Unspent gift-card balances are money thrown away; an expiry watch makes sure you use them in time.
implementation: Ingest gift-card balances into `index=personal`; alert on cards nearing expiry with a balance.
visualization: Table of gift cards by days to expiry with balance.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds you to use gift cards and vouchers before they expire, so you never waste the money.
